title: mi_html Module
content_markdown:
This module provides a minimal web user interface for the OpenSIPS's Management Interface.

Parameters for mi commands must be given in a json array format. For example, to get all statistics, the param is to be given as [["all"]]. To get only dialog and tm statistics, the param is to be given as [["dialog:","tm:"]].
overview:
This module provides a minimal web user interface for the OpenSIPS's Management Interface.

Parameters for mi commands must be given in a json array format. For example, to get all statistics, the param is to be given as [["all"]]. To get only dialog and tm statistics, the param is to be given as [["dialog:","tm:"]].

exported_parameters.name: root
exported_parameters.description: Specifies the root path for the HTTP requests. The link to the mi web interface must be constructed using the following patern: http://[opensips_IP]:[opensips_mi_port]/[root]

exported_parameters.name: http_method
exported_parameters.description: Specifies the HTTP request method to be used:

exported_parameters.name: trace_destination
exported_parameters.description: Trace destination as defined in the tracing module. Currently the only tracing module is proto_hep. This is where traced mi messages will go.
exported_parameters.notes: WARNING: A tracing module must be loaded in order for this parameter to work. (for example proto_hep).

exported_parameters.name: trace_bwlist
exported_parameters.description: Filter traced mi commands based on a blacklist or a whitelist. trace_destination must be defined for this parameter to have any purpose. Whitelists can be defined using 'w' or 'W', blacklists using 'b' or 'B'. The type is separate by the actual blacklist by ':'. The mi commands in the list must be separated by ','.
exported_parameters.example_code:
...
## blacklist ps and which mi commands
## all the other commands shall be traced
modparam("mi_html", "trace_bwlist", "b: ps, which")
...
## allow only sip_trace mi command
## all the other commands will not be traced
modparam("mi_html", "trace_bwlist", "w: sip_trace")
...
exported_parameters.notes: WARNING: One can't define both a whitelist and a blacklist. Only one of them is allowed. Defining the parameter a second time will just overwrite the first one. WARNING: A tracing module must be loaded in order for this parameter to work. (for example proto_hep).

configuration_examples.title: Set `root` parameter
configuration_examples.description:
Specifies the root path for the HTTP requests. The link to the mi web interface must be constructed using the following patern: http://[opensips_IP]:[opensips_mi_port]/[root]

The default value is "mi".

configuration_examples.title: Set `http_method` parameter
configuration_examples.description:
Specifies the HTTP request method to be used:

*   0 - use GET HTTP request
    
*   1 - use POST HTTP request
    

The default value is 0.

configuration_examples.title: Set `trace_destination` parameter
configuration_examples.description:
Trace destination as defined in the tracing module. Currently the only tracing module is proto_hep. This is where traced mi messages will go.

WARNING: A tracing module must be loaded in order for this parameter to work. (for example proto_hep).

Default value is none(not defined).

configuration_examples.title: Set `trace_destination` parameter
configuration_examples.description:
Filter traced mi commands based on a blacklist or a whitelist. trace_destination must be defined for this parameter to have any purpose. Whitelists can be defined using 'w' or 'W', blacklists using 'b' or 'B'. The type is separate by the actual blacklist by ':'. The mi commands in the list must be separated by ','.

Defining a blacklists means all the commands that are not blacklisted will be traced. Defining a whitelist means all the commands that are not whitelisted will not be traced. WARNING: One can't define both a whitelist and a blacklist. Only one of them is allowed. Defining the parameter a second time will just overwrite the first one.

WARNING: A tracing module must be loaded in order for this parameter to work. (for example proto_hep).

Default value is none(not defined).
configuration_examples.code:
...
## blacklist ps and which mi commands
## all the other commands shall be traced
modparam("mi\_html", "trace\_bwlist", "b: ps, which")
...
## allow only sip\_trace mi command
## all the other commands will not be traced
modparam("mi\_html", "trace\_bwlist", "w: sip\_trace")
...
